setting_failed: Failed to update minimum stock level
invalid_ingredients: Some ingredients do not exist or are inactive
insufficient_stock: The quantity exceeds the stock on hand
no_changes: The counted quantities match the stock; there is no difference to record
ingredient_duplicate: An ingredient with this name already exists
ingredient_in_stock: The ingredient still has stock; issue or count it down to 0, or mark it inactive
unit_locked: The ingredient already has stock movements, so its unit cannot change
ingredient_in_recipe: This ingredient is used in a dish recipe; remove it from the recipe or mark it inactive instead
expiry_required: Ingredients with expiry tracking need an expiry date
lot_not_found: Lot not found for this ingredient at this branch
